Overview
Established in 1978, MSS, Inc. comprises three distinct divisions: Relocation Support Services, Precision Packaging & Crating, and Pure Install. 

Relocation Support Services utilizes a vast, curated network of skilled technicians across North America to provide a seamless integration of specialized services to restore order and comfort to transferring employees and their families. These services include disassembly/reassembly of complex furniture, exercise and playground equipment; disconnect/reconnect of major household appliances; and crating/packaging of valuable, fragile items such as artwork, statues, glass, marble, and televisions.

Precision Packaging & Crating delivers expert crating and packaging solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of various industries, ensuring the safe transport and storage of items ranging from heavy machinery to delicate artwork. Pure Install provides customizable assembly, install, and repair/maintenance services for healthcare, hospitality, retail, commercial, residential, and vinyl and graphic needs.
